name: RP In the Mood for Love look
description: After In the Mood for Love (2000): very warm, red-amber mids and highlights over a faint green in the deep shadows, blacks slightly crushed, harder contrast, reds and pinks pushed, greens a little up, and skin allowed to go toward red as the film does. Our own numbers, measured from five stills; strength set at 130 percent of the first draft on the operator's letter, 2026-11-07.
